info.title: Beeper Desktop API
info.description: HTTP API for interacting with Beeper Desktop. Allows access to your chats from across all the chat networks. This API provides read and write access to messages, chats, and accounts through OAuth2 or Bearer token authentication. A live WebSocket endpoint is available at /v1/ws. Clients authenticate with the same access token and send subscriptions.set with chatIDs (use ["*"] for all chats). Server events are flat, typed messages: chat.upserted, chat.deleted, message.upserted, and message.deleted.
